"""
b = argmin_(i ∈ ℝ) i^2 
        where 
        a: scalar 
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, a):
        assert np.ndim(a) == 0
        def pack(i):
            return np.concatenate([[i]])
        def unpack(X):
            return X[0:1][0]
        def target(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return np.power(np.asarray(i, dtype=np.float64), 2)
        opt = minimize(target, np.zeros(1))
        i = unpack(opt.x)
        self.b = unpack(opt.x)
        self.i = i
